memory_updates.content: A genuine result on one matched task is retained as task-level evidence only. It neither establishes nor refutes the full mechanism until all frozen matched tasks are measured under comparable conditions.

Negative evidence applies only to the actually tested candidate, configuration, task, executor/model, budget, judge, replay, and sandbox conditions. Do not generalize to scientist-agent family, original method, adaptations, or untested mechanisms.

Reuse an already established provenance-equivalent matched control when its conditions are adequate; do not require duplicate scientist-agent positive-control reproduction for a claim that does not concern that family.
Preserve separate unit, mechanism, and user-level verdicts so partial evidence is neither discarded nor inflated. Candidate activation still requires its independent deterministic gate.
